verdict.rationale: Team chat products can plausibly ship AI features that connect to MCP servers, so this axis applies to Zulip. The evidence pack has no mention of MCP or of any MCP-client capability. Zulip's bot framework and native integrations are adjacent developer building blocks, not a way to plug MCP servers into the product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
